subject: sci-dym
title: SCI.DYM.------PROJ.DY.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 490 (MP(II)-8). SCI-DYM (scientific dynamics) is the subject; PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-DY (information dynamics), AFI (affinity insight) and PART (participation). From INFO-DY: ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism). From AFI: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From PART: C-INFO (composite information) and CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis). From ACC-FT: MTH (methodology). From INDIV-TD: AFL (affinity alignment) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: PER-TR (perceived transformation).
